name: Chain of Words
text:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

---
You see the thin lines of magic between your creations, and you can exploit that connection with a small shift of power from one rune to another. You Invoke two Runes within 60 feet. In addition to the runes' normal effects, a chain of glowing script flows between them, dealing max5,(floor(@actor.level/2))d6 force damage to all creatures in a straight line between them with a basic Reflex save saving throw; creatures bearing the invoked runes are not in the area of this line. A creature who critically fails its save is also Immobilized for 1 round or until it Escapes, as the runes seal its movements. The DC to Escape is your class DC. At 12th level, and every 2 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d6.
